subject: science
cluster: Patterns of the sky and seasons

items.answer: The time between sunrise and sunset when it is light

steps: Daylight is the light part of the day.

items.prompt: Which season has the most daylight?

steps: Summer has the most hours of daylight.

items.prompt: Which season has the least daylight?

steps: Winter has the fewest hours of daylight.

items.prompt: Does it get dark earlier in summer or winter?

steps: Winter has less daylight, so it gets dark earlier.

items.prompt: Are summer days longer or shorter than winter days?

steps: Summer has more daylight, so days are longer.

items.prompt: Does the amount of daylight change with the seasons?
In summer, is it light or dark after dinner?

steps: Summer has more daylight, so it stays light later.

items.prompt: In winter, is it light or dark by dinner time?

steps: Winter has less daylight, so it is dark earlier.

items.prompt: Spring and fall have daylight amounts that are ____ summer and winter.

steps: Spring and fall are between the longest and shortest days.

items.prompt: True or false: there is more daylight in summer than in winter.

steps: Summer has more daylight than winter.

items.prompt: Explain why you can play outside later in the summer evening.
items.answer: There is more daylight in summer, so it stays light later

steps: More summer daylight keeps it light into the evening.

items.prompt: How could you show daylight changes with the season?
items.answer: Check if it is light or dark at the same time in summer and winter

steps: Comparing the same time across seasons shows the change.

items.prompt: Why does the Sun set earlier in winter?
items.answer: Winter has fewer hours of daylight

steps: Less daylight means the Sun sets earlier.

items.prompt: At 8 in the evening, is it more likely to be light in June or December?

steps: June (summer) has more daylight, so it is light later.

items.prompt: Describe how the amount of daylight is related to the time of year.
items.answer: There is more daylight in summer and less in winter

steps: Daylight is longest in summer and shortest in winter.
